name: timesfm
description: TimesFM (Time Series Foundation Model) is a pretrained time-series foundation model developed by Google Research for time-series forecasting.
one_liner: A ready-made AI model from Google that predicts future numbers — sales, demand, traffic — from past data, without needing to build or train your own forecasting model.
buyer: A retail or logistics operations manager who currently forecasts demand in spreadsheets and needs more accurate, automated predictions without hiring a data science team.
business_use_cases: A small e-commerce brand plugs in past sales data to forecast next month's inventory needs and avoid overstocking or stockouts.
A logistics company forecasts shipment volumes per route to plan staffing and vehicle allocation ahead of time.
A local utility or restaurant chain forecasts demand (electricity load, foot traffic) to optimize staffing and supply orders.

money_ideas.idea: Build a simple SaaS that lets small retailers upload a sales CSV and get a demand forecast dashboard, powered by this model underneath.
Offer forecasting-as-a-service consulting to SMBs who have data but no in-house forecasting expertise.

steal_this: This weekend, build a one-page tool where a shop owner uploads last year's sales CSV and gets back a simple next-90-days demand forecast chart, and charge a small flat fee per report.
